blurb.text: A small Napa Valley AVA, only about one by three miles, noted for Cabernet Sauvignon and Petite Sirah. Clay loam from the Napa River and volcanic soil from the Vaca Mountains set it apart. A 1973 Stag's Leap Cabernet ranked first at the 1976 Judgment of Paris.
